title: SL Traffic Fine Management System
summary: Digital platform for automating traffic violation processing, fine issuing, and official payment records.
problem: Manual paper-based traffic ticketing in Sri Lanka causes processing delays, lost records, and inefficient fine settlement.
solution: Engineered a full-stack digital management platform streamlining traffic officer ticketing, driver notifications, and centralized payment tracking.
features: Officer violation logging interface with instant fine calculation
Centralized database storing driver license numbers, violation codes, and payment statuses
Responsive web portal for drivers to inspect ticket details and settle fines online
